notes: Headline all-items HICP for BG (ECOICOP ver.2, TOTAL, annual rate of change). index_by_year and latest_index carry Eurostat's published index values unmodified, at the unit named in each row's api_url_index — open it and the same digits come back. What is ours is the SELECTION: index_by_year takes the December reading of each year out of the monthly series (a year without a December is omitted) and starts at 2020, and latest_index is the most recent month published. The annual rate of change is Eurostat's own figure, unmodified.
